actions.script: const definition=ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.report.ReportServices.get#Definition').parameters({definitionId}).call().definition if (definition.type!=='report' || definition.body.kind!=='playlist') throw new Error('Choose a dashboard playlist') const at=Number(index || 0),items=definition.body.playlist || [] if (!Number.isInteger(at) || at<0 || at>=items.length) throw new Error('Choose a playlist item') const id=items[at].definitionId const output=ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.report.ReportServices.render#Dashboard').parameters({definitionId:id,from:from || 'now-7d',thru:thru || 'now'}).call().dashboard output.definitionId=id;output.absoluteTime=output.range const frames={};for (const [panelId,panel] of Object.entries(output.panels || {})) frames[panelId]=panel.frames || [] ec.web.sendJsonResponse({dashboard:output,frames})
